strings.en: No contact...?
Yes, the Mars Frontier Base... We can't reach them at all.
The talk that they've joined hands with the Za Boom Army
and are plotting to seize control of the Earth Sphere...
Yes... It may not be a joke after all.
I can't say whether it's related, but... Meganoids have appeared.
Meganoids on Earth too...!?
Captain Misumaru also reported that they'd appeared on Mars, but...
Oh? I thought the Nadesico would be staying on Mars a little longer...
Long time no see, Captain Bright.
Banjo, I hear you were quite active on Mars too.
On Mars, the Nadesico...
We got kinda surrounded by enemies, so we ran away super quick!
Ha ha ha, but knowing when to pull back is
an important quality in a captain. The Nadesico seems to have a good one.
With so much still unclear... as originally planned, the Nadesico
will be accompanying the Londo Bell unit.
Captain Misumaru... the admiral is always worried about you.
Please try not to do anything too reckless.
Jeez! Father never stops treating me like a child!
Fathers never want to admit their children have grown up...
Anyway, we didn't completely destroy Don and Koros in the last battle...
so I figured the Meganoids might come back.
Meganoids... Then isn't Commander Hazard of the Mars base
involved in this as well?
It also bothers me that the Nadesico couldn't make contact on Mars...
We're about to launch our assault on Jaburo.
...We can't spare anything for Mars, but...
Our own forces have been growing. Please don't worry about us.
Then again, we can't help you in the battle for Jaburo either...
Good luck.
Understood. It's almost time, so I'll sign off.
Right. Please give my regards to Amuro and Kamille...
Sounds like things are rough on the surface...
A lot seems to have happened on the ground while we were out of contact.
So the Elshank was an ally... But this ninja's identity is unknown,
which is a strange story.
If Amuro and Kamille are back in action,
there's little to worry about... If anything, what concerns me
is the Meganoids... and the Gundam GP02A matter.
The Gundam Project's Unit 2...! If I remember right, that one...
No one knows where it went... Could it be Jaburo after all?
...It bugs me.
Koji?
The Dangaioh team's outfits. Those are... trouble, man.
Huh.
Twisting around things we don't know won't lead anywhere good.
More to the point, I question letting the Dangaioh team wander
around dressed like that.
That's not relevant right now, is it, Tetsuya...?
Looks like everyone's bothered by those outfits...
W-Well, of course...
Boys will be boys...
So Akito likes that kind of thing too... Then I'll...!
Oh my, you can only dress like that while you're young.
Besides, a captain dressed like that would be a distraction. Skip it?
Tell her more firmly, please. ...She's all fired up to do it.
Wow, this might be fun. ...The people at the center of it all...
I was gonna go tease them, but it's not really the mood for it...
Shazara... Lilith... Is our planet... really...?
Lamba...
Princess... please take heart. We're still here... Lilith...
The people of Lilith have not perished yet...
Shazara...
Lamba...
I... I... Shazara...
That... couldn't be helped, Lamba... It was the only way...
We... can't afford to lose.
So that no more people have to suffer like that...
we have to beat the Bunker...
That's how it is, Lamba. We've still got to get our revenge, right?
No time to mope around. Pull yourself together.
Pai! Don't put it like that...
Mm... It's okay, Mia. Thanks, Pai... Right, there's no time for that.
You're just like us, Lamba.
But as long as we don't give up, it's not all over yet.
That's right. We can't let anyone else lose their home like we did...
Let's fight on together.
Right...!
Well, look who's saying smart stuff.
...What's up, Shinobu?
I was gonna give that cocky punk Pai a piece of my mind,
but... it ain't really the mood for it...
Oh? Reading the room? You've grown up, Shinobu.
Shut up.
Still, this room's nothing but aliens, huh?
How do things stand, Mashymre?
...Yes, things around Earth have been very turbulent lately.
The aliens' offensive has the Federation unable to make a move...
I would like to take advantage of this and act, but...
...The aliens have been meddling with us as well.
Lumping us in with the foolish old humanity that clings to Earth!
I drive them off each time, Lady Haman.
And is it not also true that because of it, Londo Bell remains undealt with,
Mashymre?
That's...! No, my apologies.
Very well... Have you nothing else to report?
Yes, the Delaz Fleet... appears to be making its move.
...Operation... Stardust...?
Precisely.
At present, I am sending Cima's fleet to that sector.
There... that person is due to join them.
...Those who carry on the late Aiguille Delaz's will, eh?
Very well. Prepare for our next move, Mashymre.
Yes, at once!
(Foolish old humanity clinging to Earth... was it?)
Brother, Captain Bright wants everyone to discuss our next move...
Brother... Brother!? What's wrong!?
Ah... Oh, Maria, I'm fine. There's nothing to worry about.
It's an old wound from the Vega Star Federation's attack on Fleed...
What an awful wound... I had no idea you were hurt like this...
We need to get you to a doctor right away!
It's no use, Maria. This wound... is from Vegatron radiation...
Earth's science can't heal it.
Vegatron radiation...? Then, Brother, you're...!
Yes... I may not have very long to live.
But I can't just sit and wait for that day to come!
No! At least rest quietly...
Listen, Maria... Grendizer can't leave the fight now.
Besides, I don't want to worry everyone needlessly.
Don't tell anyone about this.
But, Brother...
Come now, it's not certain that I'll die.
We may yet find a way. Don't look so worried.
...The pain's gone now anyway. Come, let's go see Captain Bright.
(...Vegatron radiation... If I don't do something, Brother will...)
Everyone's here...?
...Sounds like you've learned something, Captain.
Yes. ...Neo Zeon has made its move.
Looks like... they've finally run out of patience.
Lucky for us we caught wind of it first, right?
So where is it?
Konpeito... the place once called Solomon...
A large Neo Zeon force is heading there.
One of the Federation's bases... I see.
Jaburo's been seized by someone, and...
the Gate of Zedan hasn't fully worked since the Gryps Conflict...
That leaves Luna II, Von Braun... and...
...Konpeito, then.
So the enemy's finally getting serious, huh?
Let's hurry.
The Gaizok are quiet lately. We need to thin the enemy's numbers...
And the Vega Star Federation. It's time we went on the offensive.
If we crush Zeon here and Tetsuya and the others
take back Jaburo... we could ride that momentum!
That'd be the best.
If we strike Zeon here and Koji's Gandor Team
takes Jaburo... couldn't the Federation recover in one go?
That's idealistic... but I'd like to hope so.
...I have a bad feeling, but... it seems there's no other choice, Captain.
A bad feeling...?
What is it, Captain?
For an enemy operation... their movements just seem sloppy.
...But we don't have many options.
Meaning we've gotta go, right?
Gorman! Gorman, are you there!?
What is it, Commander Gandal?
The Earthlings are on the move... apparently the side opposing
the one that Duke Fleed is with.
Oh...? So if we seize them...
It's very likely Duke Fleed will show himself.
...Heh heh, what fools. Fighting among themselves is one thing,
but handing us a chance like this... Heh, ha ha ha ha!
Can you do it, Gorman?
Who do you think you're talking to, Commander? Right, I'm off...!
I heard Nergal's sending us a new Aestivalis and a new pilot...
What? A new Aestivalis!? ...Is that it!?
Ooooh!?
What's this, what's this frame? A new model, huh?
The face is different! And the generator's so compact!!
Plus the skin's so silky smooth!
Knock yourself out!
Still, when'd they find time to build a new model?
It's a newer version than our Aestivalises! No fair!
Hmph!
Now, now... don't be so jealous.
Hm?
Nergal planned its next move in case the Scaparelli Project failed.
Who are you people!?
Heh... I'm Nagare Akatsuki.
I'm Erina Kinjo Won.
Nergal sent us here, him as a pilot and me as vice-helmsman.
Think of us as space pirates, gathered under the flag of freedom...
Pirates got nothin' to do with it.
And some reinforcement--just one Aestivalis and one pilot?
Now, now. Maybe Nergal's finances are tight too, huh?
(This guy doesn't seem much like a pilot... Who is he?)
Judau! Judau Ashta! What are you doing there!?
The Double Zeta's maintenance is already done!
Whoops, don't mind me. Call it a junk dealer's habit,
but I can't relax unless I check a machine I'm riding myself.
I check every Gundam here myself, you know?
I'd like you to ride with peace of mind.
Yeah, yeah. ...This thing's mechanisms are complicated.
Guess it can't be helped that it took so long to assemble.
Phew. ...Well, it's a heavy mobile suit on par with GP02,
combining the mechanisms of the original Gundam and the G-Armor,
the ultimate Gundam, in a sense...
That's this MSZ-010, better known as the ZZ Gundam.
What deserves special mention is the High Mega Cannon on its forehead...
Ahh, okay, I get it already!
I heard that so much while assembling it, I could recite it!
It's the kind of machine people either love or hate, but I like it.
It's got a flavor all its own.
The Double Zeta was a useful reference for our own research too.
It might even be applicable to my Gundam.
...Well then, take care, Judau Ashta.
Roger. Your name came up a minute ago... GP02.
It's fine if I smash it to pieces, right?
...Yes.
...Are you hiding something?
Huh? No... I'm not hiding anything.
Eh, whatever. Grown-ups are good at keeping secrets. ...Well, I'm off.
...Give my regards to Captain Bright, then.
Yeah, I'm off to lend Londo Bell a hand!
...Oh, right. If you're hiding stuff, hide that "my Gundam" line.
Isn't that kinda bad?
That's fine.
